meta.name: continuity-ledger
meta.description: Create or update continuity ledger for state preservation across clears

copy.tagline: 创建或更新连续性账本以跨清除保持状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在清除操作后保留系统状态。
copy.tagline_en: Create or update continuity ledger to preserve state across clears
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to preserve system state after clear operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在每次对话结束前询问会话结果，然后创建一个 YAML 格式的“交接文档”，记录本次会话的目标、完成的任务、决策、发现和下一步计划。下次新对话时，你可以用 /resume_handoff 命令加载这个文档，恢复之前的状态。
howto.when: 当你准备执行 /clear 命令、上下文使用量接近 70% 或进行多天、复杂的任务时触发。

say.text: 我们这次会话快结束了，创建交接文档吧。
say.note: Claude 会询问会话结果并生成 handoff 文件。

say.text: 帮我创建一个交接文档，会话名称是 bug-fix。
say.note: Claude 会按指定名称创建 handoff 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask about the session outcome before ending, then create a YAML handoff document recording the goal, completed tasks, decisions, findings, and next steps. In a new session, you can use /resume_handoff to load this document and restore state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are about to run /clear, context usage approaches 70%+, or during multi-day/complex tasks.

say_en.text: Let's create a handoff document before we end this session.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about the session outcome and generate the handoff file.

say_en.text: Create a handoff document with session name bug-fix.
say_en.note: Claude will create the handoff file with the specified name.
